findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_teaming_strategy, analyze_rfp_amendment_diff, analyze_debriefing_bid_protest · Private data: search_historical_awards, get_live_solicitations, generate_igce_price_to_win · Public sink: generate_teaming_strategy, generate_igce_price_to_win, analyze_debriefing_bid_protest, generate_gsa_mas_offer · Destructive: generate_rfp_response.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_teaming_strategy, analyze_rfp_amendment_diff, analyze_debriefing_bid_protest · Private data: search_historical_awards, get_live_solicitations, generate_igce_price_to_win · Public sink: generate_teaming_strategy, generate_igce_price_to_win, analyze_debriefing_bid_protest, generate_gsa_mas_offer · Destructive: generate_rfp_response

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
